svg.title: Match Carioca, an independent hackathon prototype, not a city service. Daycare seats in 2025: what changes if they are filled child by child? Share of children placed: priority group 78.0% in the real process and 93.5% in the simulation; everyone else 76.8% and 59.2%. Priority group: score 51 or more, which in 2025 means registered in CadÚnico. Anonymized data; the source warns its indicators do not represent reality. My part: Front end for the family and city-office views, wiring the allocation engine into the API, and documentation. Team project. Result: One of 5 finalist teams out of 42 at Claude Impact Lab Rio. The simulation places 912 fewer children in total: 48,680 to 47,768. Built with: HTML, CSS, JavaScript, Python, FastAPI, Gale-Shapley deferred acceptance.
